_goal: THE TUNING GOAL (owner 2026-11-26: 'I can barely fight 1v1 and it's obvious you haven't balanced yet'; lessons rule 81). A level-N hero using their abilities kills ONE level-N normal monster in about 6-10 s and loses at most 35% of their health; TWO at once is a real fight they win with abilities and rolls; THREE is dangerous (a real chance to lose); a boss is a long fight for one hero and fine for a group; the weapon alone still wins a 1v1, slowly. Measured by tools/sim-fights.mjs (every base class at levels 1/3/5/10 against 1, 2 and 3 same-level monsters of every kind in the region; the bot casts its bar, rolls out of half the tells, wears the plain kit to level 3 and magic finds from level 5) and pinned by tests/rules/balance.test.mjs. Rerun after any class, spell or monster change.
_doc: Oathwild's own combat knobs (js/rules/combat.js is the one reader). Damage maths is Farhold's (rpg.strike); these are the world sim's timings, ranges, stamina costs and death rules.

projectile._explodeDoc: An exploding ball (a bolt row with explode: { radius }, e.g. the fireball) is big: it touches a foe `explodeExtra` metres further out than a plain bolt, bursts on the first foe it touches, at the aimed ground point, or at the end of its range, and the burst hits everything within explode.radius (js/rules/combat.js burst).

aimAssist._doc: How far off the aim line (degrees) a target-an-ally or beam spell still finds someone.

stamina._doc: Stamina pays for a dodge roll and a power attack (a held swing). There is no run button and no block button (owner 2026-11-25): walking is simply faster (attributes.json base.moveSpeed) and a shield blocks on its own (`block` below). The dodge (owner 2026-11-26: 'improve movement and dodging') is a roll of `dodgeMetres` over `dodgeSeconds`, untouchable for the first `dodgeSafeSeconds` of it, then `dodgeCooldown` seconds before the next; `dodge` stamina each, so a fresh hero rolls 3-4 times in a row and again a few seconds later.

block._doc: A shield in the off hand blocks by itself, no button (owner 2026-11-25: 'block should be auto chance, more like WoW'). Each physical blow from the front half (`frontDegrees` wide, centred on where the hero faces) has the shield's `chance` (percent) to be blocked; a block stops `stops` of the blow, plus any flat blockPower from gear. Block chance from passives, talents and gear adds to the shield's own, but only while a shield is held. A quiver and a magic ward are not shields here. Guessed numbers.

combatState._doc: A body is 'in combat' while a monster has it on its threat list or it hit or was hit in the last `seconds`.

regen._doc: Out of combat, share of maximum health and mana back per second (in combat only the sheet's own regen).

special._doc: Owner report #137 (2026-11-26): 'Wolves and boars attack with a cone effect indicator … should be reserved only for special attacks where it is feasible to dodge them. These indicators seem to deal damage even if you dodge them.' A monster's blows are plain (a short lean-back, no mark on the ground, `plainWindup` s, x`plainDamage`) except every `every`-th, which is a SPECIAL blow: the red cone (or line for a shooter) shows for `windup` s, it hits x`damage`, reaches `reachBonus` m further, and you can roll out of it. Bosses do a special every `bossEvery`-th blow. While winding up a monster no longer turns (windupTurn 0): the blow lands exactly where the mark shows (lessons rule 22).

monsters._windupDoc: Every monster blow has a tell (lessons rule 39; owner 2026-11-26: 'make dodging work'): it stops, turns to its target and winds up for `windup` seconds (a monster row may set its own; bosses `windupBoss`, shooters `windupRanged`) while a red mark shows on the ground; then it strikes whoever is still in front of it (within `windupArcDegrees`) and within reach + `windupReachSlack`. It turns at most `windupTurn` radians a second while winding up (0 since owner report #137: the blow lands where the mark shows), so a roll to the side or back takes you out of it; plain vs special blows: `special`; a roll through it is untouchable anyway. A stagger or knockdown cancels the blow. The time between blows stays `attackEvery` (at least `recoverMin` after a blow).

death._doc: A player at 0 health is downed for `downedSeconds` (an ally can revive them by holding Interact for `reviveSeconds` within `reviveRange`, back at `reviveShare` health); after that, or by choice, they respawn at their last shrine paying `goldShare` of their gold (at most goldCapPerLevel x level) and inventory.json durability.respawnLoss.

xpRange._doc: Players further than this from a kill get no XP or loot from it (they did not help, or wandered off).

pets._doc: Summoned companions: their health/damage come from their monster row at the caster's level, x the summon's power and the caster's petPct.

monsterScale._doc: Oathwild's monsters live longer than Farhold's (owner: WoW-like fights). x on every monster's health and damage at spawn (companions are not scaled). 2026-11-26 retune against `_goal` (tools/sim-fights.mjs): health 3 -> 6.5 and growth 30% -> 28% a level (the rebuilt class abilities killed a same-level monster in 1-3 s), damage 1.7 -> 1.9 but growth 10% -> 5% a level (a fresh hero lost a third of their health to one level-1 monster; level-10 fights last longer, so each blow grows less). Lead pass 2026-11-26: health 6.5 -> 9 together with smaller spell ranks (+25/+50%), class depth +2% a level and hero weapons growing +8% a level (attributes.json base.meleePerLevel), so abilities stop one-shotting and the weapon keeps up. Then health 9 -> 7 with growth 1.28 -> 1.316 a level (farholdEnemies): level 10 unchanged, level 1 a fifth softer so the weapon alone still wins a level-1 fight. bossDmg: extra on a boss's blows (was a fixed 1.2 in code; 1.0 since monster damage grows 1.13 a level — a solo hero must still finish the main story, tests/world/campaign.test.mjs). bossHp: extra health on a boss (was a fixed 1.5 in code; 1.0 since base health went to 7 — a solo cleric took 85-150 s per boss and timed out on three).

newHero._doc: Owner 2026-11-26 (first character, level-1 hero vs a level-2 boar: 406 health against his 79, died with it at 20%): the first levels are gentler. Monster health and damage x this at each monster level (1-4), 1 from level 5 on. The sim bot plays far better than a new player, so these are read against `tools/sim-fights.mjs --foe 1 --dodge 0.25`.

farholdEnemies._doc: Laid over farhold/data/balance.json `enemies` in memory (js/rules/engine.js): how fast a monster's health and damage grow per level. Oathwild's characters grow faster per level than Farhold's (class points, ranks, class depth), so its monsters do too. Lead pass 2026-11-26: damage growth 1.05 -> 1.13 a level (from level 5 up a hero lost almost nothing to a same-level monster).

magicWeapon._doc: A magic weapon attacks with spell power in its own style (js/rules/casters.js, data/casters.json): `mult` is every style's base share (a style's own share multiplies it); `element` and `range` are the plain bolt of a quarterstaff or an orb left in the main hand.

formSwing._doc: Seconds between a shape's basic attacks (a wolf's bite, a bear's swipe) before haste; each attack lands the shape's `hits`.

_packOdds: A fighting monster's pack in a roam zone: odds of 1, 2, 3 (cut to the roster row's `pack` range; never more than 3). Owner 2026-11-26: "every enemy I have seen has been in a pack of 5 or more … I can barely fight 1v1". js/world/encounters.js packSize reads it; peaceful herds roll evenly.

campGroups._doc: A camp of `from` or more monsters with no hand layout (regions.json spawn `at`) splits itself: groups of `size` on a ring `ring` metres round the middle, the boss in the middle, noticing at `notice` metres (owner 2026-11-25: large packs a hero cannot kill). js/rules/combat.js spawnCamp is the reader.

knock._doc: Knockback and knockdown (owner 2026-11-26: 'I want things to get blown apart by fireball explosions and smack things in a circle knocking down enemies around me'). A spell row's `knock: { push, down, stagger }` throws the target `push` metres away from the blow over a short flight (airMin..airMax seconds, longer for longer throws; the server's ground check runs every step, so nobody flies through a wall or off a cliff), then, with `down` > 0, it lies knocked down for `down` seconds plus `standUp` to get up: no moving, no attacking, no casting, normal damage taken. `rank` scales push and down for tougher bodies (a boss barely moves). A blow that takes `heavyShare` of a monster's health in one hit staggers it for `heavyStagger` seconds (it loses its swing) — not bosses. Heroes are never thrown (no monster carries a knock yet). js/rules/combat.js knockUnit is the reader.

rush._doc: Spells that move the caster (js/rules/combat.js rush; the browser's prediction runs the same steps, so nothing snaps back). `leap`: the hero jumps to the aimed ground point (at most the row's `range`) over `leapSeconds`, cannot be hit in the air, and on landing hits everything within the row's `radius` (with its `knock`). `dash` (a charge): the hero runs the row's dash range at `dashSpeed` metres a second, hitting each foe it passes once, untouchable while it runs.
